title: Lieutenant M C Macgregor Law and Men Of The 6th Duke Of Wellingtons Regt
memorial_details:
description: (RH LIGHT) VIRTUTIS FORTUNA COMES/ THE WEST RIDING/ TO THE GLORY OF GOD AND/ IN MEMORY OF THE/ OFFICERS AND MEN OF THE/ 6TH DUKE OF WELLINGTON'S/ WEST RIDING REGIMENT SERVING/ IN THE 49TH AND 62ND DIVISIONS/ WHO FELL IN FRANCE AND FLANDERS/ DURING THE GREAT WAR 1914 - 1918/ THEY REST FROM THEIR LABOURS AND THEIR/ WORKS DO FOLLOW THEM
(LF LIGHT) HINDOOSTAN/ THE WEST RIDING/ TO THE GLORY OF GOD AND/ IN LOVING MEMORY OF/ MALCOLM COLIN MACGREGOR/ SON OF DUNCAN GEORGE AND EMILY/ LAW OF HAWKSWORTH HALL/ LIEUT. 6TH DUKE OF WELLINGTON'S/ WEST RIDING RGT WHO DIED OF/ WOUNDS RECEIVED IN ACTION NEAR YPRES/ 29TH DEC 1915. DULCE ET DECORUM EST PRO PATRIA MORI
(ACROSS BOTH LIGHTS) THEIR NAME LIVETH FOR EVERMORE
